paper_title: The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful   Communication Datasets
caption: Conceptualized and operationalized targets by year along with the distribution of datasets. Targeted refers to datasets that have explicitly mentioned at least one target in their construct definition (i.e., in the conceptualization phase) and/or publications in which the authors define concrete measures to ensure and validate the presence of at least one target group in the data (i.e., in the operationalization phase). Untargeted refers to all other datasets that do not meet these two criteria. Note that the data for 2022 is only partially available (as described in our Methods and Data Section).
model_annotation: This stacked bar chart illustrates the number of datasets per year, categorized by whether their targets are untargeted or targeted. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Year," and displays discrete years from 2012 to 2022 arranged in chronological order. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Number of datasets," utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 160, with numeric tick labels and corresponding horizontal grid lines spaced at regular intervals of 20. The chart features stacked bars where the bottom component, colored blue, represents "Untargeted" datasets, and the top component, colored orange, represents "Targeted" datasets, as defined by a legend titled "Targets" located in the upper left corner. The total height of the stacked bars generally increases from left to right up until the year 2021. The shortest bars appear in 2012 and 2013, both totaling approximately 2 datasets; the 2012 bar consists almost entirely of the orange targeted category, while the 2013 bar consists almost entirely of the blue untargeted category. The tallest bar occurs in 2021, reaching exactly 160 on the value axis, composed of approximately 67 blue untargeted datasets and 93 orange targeted datasets. Other intermediate total values include roughly 13 datasets in 2016, 48 in 2018, 65 in 2019, and 131 in 2020. The categories are sorted chronologically, and the final bar for the year 2022 is visually emphasized by using lighter, faded shades of blue and orange compared to the solid, opaque colors of the preceding years, displaying a total height of approximately 37 datasets.
